data.content_ref: inline:The problem 061ddfcce3bb depends on SRC_002's 'Resolution Dependency' to argue that 'mere compliance' is only possible when the checklist resolution is high enough to automate the outcome, whereas 'genuine reliability' emerges when the agent must resolve gaps in low-resolution checklists. This relation is refuted if a high-resolution checklist still fails to produce reliable outcomes without the agent's intuitive intervention.
